2607.08046.title: What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
2607.08046.paper_summary: Large language models fine-tuned for forecasting can be accurate yet poorly calibrated, and their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning may not faithfully reflect the evidence behind a forecast. We ask whether internal representations offer a more direct window into both. Working with Eternis-Forecaster 8B on OpenForesight, we train representation-pooling probes on intermediate activations and find they achieve substantially better calibration; a result that also holds for GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Air. We then assess CoT faithfulness through evidence ablation and diversionary injection: removing an influential source in the prompt often changes the model's forecast while leaving the reasoning trace untouched. The same probes function as lie detectors: their activations track behavioral shifts far better than the reasoning trace does, and they also predict the direction of change in 84% of cases, including when the CoT conceals the perturbation's influence. Finally, forced answering reveals that forecasts are largely fixed before reasoning begins: a single pre-reasoning pass recovers the committed answer and confidence, and routing questions by the spread of this pre-set answer distribution saves 30-47% of generated tokens, with no loss of accuracy. Together, these results establish probing internal representations as a practical tool for calibrating, auditing, and triaging language model forecasters and reasoning models more broadly.
2607.08046.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型經過預測微調後可能準確但校準不佳，而它們的思考鏈（CoT）推理可能無法真實反映預測背後的證據。我們詢問內部表徵是否提供了更直接的窗口來觀察這兩者。使用Eternis-Forecaster 8B在OpenForesight上，我們對中間激活進行表徵池探測訓練，發現它們實現了顯著更好的校準；這一結果對GLM-4.7-Flash和GLM-4.5-Air同樣適用。然後，我們通過證據消融和轉移注入來評估CoT的真實性：在提示中移除一個有影響力的來源通常會改變模型的預測，同時不改變推理痕跡。這些探測器同時充當謊言檢測器：它們的激活比推理痕跡更好地追踪行為變化，並且在84%的情況下預測變化的方向，包括當CoT隱藏擾動的影響時。最後，強制回答顯示預測在推理開始之前基本上是固定的：一次單一的預推理通過恢復了已承諾的答案和信心，並且通過這一預設答案分佈的擴散路由問題可以節省30-47%的生成標記，且不損失準確性。總體而言，這些結果確立了探測內部表徵作為校準、審計和更廣泛地篩選語言模型預測者和推理模型的實用工具。
